newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danone expands Argentine dairy operations.
newsitem.headline: Danone expands Argentine dairy operations.

text.p: French food group Danone said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Argentina's Mastellone group to extend the scope of their local fresh cheese and desserts venture to yoghurts.
As a result, Danone's output in Argentina will rise in just one year from 36,000 tonnes of fresh cheese and desserts to 156,000 tonnes of dairy products, the company said in a statement.
Sales revenue will jump from 500 million francs to 1.5 billion francs, it said.
The venture set up in December 1995 is 51 percent controlled by Danone.
Mastellone controls 61 percent of Argentine's fast growing yoghurt market.
Argentine's per capita consumption of yoghurts has nearly doubled in five years to reach an annual 7.5 kilograms.
